effects.printed_clause: 1 Level 8 Eclipse Observer monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
effects.lua_implementation: EnableReviveLimit and AddFusionProcFun2 combine a Level 8 Eclipse Observer monster filter with an unrestricted Spellcaster race filter and require two distinct materials.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses aux.AddFusionProcFun2 to combine two different functional material predicates, including Card.IsLevelAbove for a printed Level condition.

effects.printed_clause: Your Eclipse Observer cards on your field or in your GY are unaffected by the effects of Eclipse Quick-Play Spells.
effects.lua_implementation: A field EFFECT_IMMUNE_EFFECT targets Eclipse Observer cards in the controller's on-field and GY locations, and accepts only effects whose handler is an Eclipse-named Quick-Play Spell. The audit added official Book of Lunar Eclipse to that source pool.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses EFFECT_IMMUNE_EFFECT with a value callback that examines the incoming effect and also applies archetype-filtered field protection through SetTargetRange.

effects.issue: Confirmed source-pool defect: effects of official Book of Lunar Eclipse (31834488) did not receive the printed immunity because only Book of Eclipse was explicitly recognized outside the CCG setcode.

effects.printed_clause: While your opponent has 3 or more cards in their hand, this card cannot be destroyed or targeted by card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: Two cloned single effects share a live opponent-hand-count condition and register EFFECT_INDESTRUCTABLE_EFFECT plus EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET while the count is at least three.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers paired EFFECT_INDESTRUCTABLE_EFFECT and EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET protections from one shared filtered protection definition.

effects.printed_clause: While your opponent has 6 or more cards in their hand, your opponent has no hand size limit.
effects.lua_implementation: A player-targeting EFFECT_HAND_LIMIT applies to the opponent while their current hand count is at least six and supplies a practical unlimited value of 99.

official_references.matched_structure: Implements no hand size limit with player-targeting EFFECT_HAND_LIMIT and a high numeric value.

effects.printed_clause: While your opponent has 9 or more cards in their hand, once per turn (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 Eclipse Quick-Play Spell from your GY; this effect becomes that card's activation effect.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand-count-gated Quick Effect finds an activatable Eclipse-named Quick-Play Spell in the GY, banishes it as cost, captures its activation target/operation with CheckActivateEffect or the engine activation-effect fallback, and forwards target state and operation. SetCountLimit(1,id) supplies the once-per-turn limit. The source pool now includes both official Eclipse Books.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses CheckActivateEffect on a selected Spell/Trap in the GY, forwards its target callback and label state, then executes the captured activation operation as another monster's effect.

effects.issue: Confirmed copy-pool defect: official Book of Lunar Eclipse was a legal Eclipse Quick-Play Spell by name but could not be selected before the audit added ID 31834488. The GetActivateEffect fallback remains a CCG compatibility extension for activations that CheckActivateEffect cannot snapshot.
